lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice using perfekt to talk about what has happened so far and why it matters now.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Checking progress on a weekly task or shared plan.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Updating someone about current status and present relevance.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik check what has already been done this week and what still remains before the weekend.

main_focus.name: perfekt for present relevance
main_focus.description: Use har plus supine to show that a past action affects the current situation.
model_examples: Vi har inte fått svaret än.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use perfekt naturally 5-6 times in the dialogue.

useful_chunks: Vi har inte fått svar än.
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Include common perfekt chunks with already, not yet, and still remaining.

dialogue_shape.opening: One person asks for a quick status update.
dialogue_shape.middle: They list what has already happened, what has not happened yet, and why it matters now.
dialogue_shape.ending: They decide the next small action before the weekend.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat har plus supine with different everyday verbs

focus: what is still missing or delayed
the next action that is needed

sentence_focus: one sentence with har redan plus supine
one sentence with har inte plus supine plus än
one question asking what is left
one sentence about something being almost ready
one sentence connecting current status to a next step
